title: Joe Oliver leads the Onward band; Labor Day parade
summary: Oliver took over the Onward band when Perez left for Chicago; the band played a colored Labor Day parade.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline
